transcription.text: Your cheatin' heart will make you weep You'll cry and cry and try to sleep But sleep won't come the whole night through Your cheatin' heart will tell on you When tears come down like falling rain You'll toss around and call my name You'll walk the floor the way I do Your cheatin' heart will tell on you Your cheatin' heart will pine someday And crave the love you threw away The time will come when you'll be blue Your cheatin' heart will tell on you When tears come down like falling rain You'll toss around and call my name You'll walk the floor the way I do Your cheatin' heart will tell on you
